description.value: Subway at 1568 Fort St is a franchise sandwich shop located in the Stadacona Centre Building in Victoria's Fernwood neighbourhood, offering Footlongs, 6" sandwiches, wraps, and salads. Breakfast service is available, and orders can be placed in-restaurant, online, via pickup, delivery, or curbside. All locations are independently owned and operated.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (4 spaces, covered) at 16m; rack (4 spaces, covered) at 70m. Total: 8 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active Subway franchise at 1568 Fort St in Victoria's Stadacona Centre Building, with phone and address matching OSM tags. OSM tag takeaway=yes and website's 'Order Pick Up / Order Delivery' options confirm takeout. No website or OSM evidence exists for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist-specific amenities.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, publicly accessible fast-food location confirmed by website. Useful to touring cyclists as a reliable food stop with takeout options.
